test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions. Consider the statements and conclusions to be true even if they vary from commonly known facts and then decide which of the conclusions follow/(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some flowers are petals.

2. Some birds are petals.

3. No bird is a flower.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some petals are birds.

(II) Some flowers are birds.

(III) Some petals are flowers.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb8a5c5758f35d76db35d90c6ecf119dffdac1eec933b209e52a805d66188bd0.png] 

Conclusions:

I) Some petals are birds. Follows (In the given statements mentioned some birds are petals. So some petals are birds as follows)

II) Some flowers are birds. Not Follows (In the given statement mentioned no bird is a flower. So some flowers are birds is not followed)

III) Some petals are flowers. Follows (In the given statement mentioned some flowers are petals. So this conclusion is followed)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions I and III follow".**
